if(CONFIG_ZMK_DISPLAY AND CONFIG_BOREK_VIEW_WIDGET_STATUS)
  zephyr_library_include_directories(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
  zephyr_library_sources(custom_status_screen.c)
  zephyr_library_sources(widgets/util.c)
  zephyr_library_sources(widgets/art.c)

  # Image data generated by images/convert.py.
  file(GLOB ART_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS widgets/art/*.c)
  zephyr_library_sources(${ART_SOURCES})

  if(NOT CONFIG_ZMK_SPLIT OR CONFIG_ZMK_SPLIT_ROLE_CENTRAL)
    zephyr_library_sources(widgets/central_status.c)
    zephyr_library_sources(src/split_sync_central.c)
  else()
    zephyr_library_sources(widgets/peripheral_status.c)
    zephyr_library_sources(src/split_sync_peripheral.c)
  endif()
endif()
